description:
## Goal

Every map is an immutable sorted sequence with exactly one entry per strict structural key. Construction, replacement, deletion, lookup, iteration, runtime comparison, strict equality, and quoted-source raw-map addressing ask one comparison authority. Equal independently allocated tuple, list, nested-map, and binary keys collide and the last input value wins.

## Signal

The map %{{:x, 1} => :first, {:x, 1} => :last} has one entry, and lookup with a freshly allocated {:x, 1} returns :last on interp, JIT, and AOT. The same holds for lists and recursively composite keys. Allocation noise, input order, GC, and cross-heap transport do not change key order or lookup answers. Quoted expansion consumes runtime map order directly and adds no sorting or reconstruction pass.

## Current contradiction

Construction is not fine. heap/key_cmp.rs compares lists, tuples, maps, closures, and resources by moving addresses, so separately allocated equal composite keys remain separate entries. The existing structural equality and term-order traversal in ir_runtime.rs is a second partial answer: it widens 1 and 1.0, omits struct schema identity from ordering, allocates cloned schema field vectors while comparing, and assumes map storage is already ordered by its own relation. GC rewrites key pointers without sorting, disproving address order as a persistent invariant.

fz-kdt.17 supplies the prerequisite typed source denotation carried by closures. Resources already have one off-heap owner; add a typed ResourceId to that owner and preserve it through stubs, GC, and transport. Do not add an identity registry or use a stub address.

Named-struct identity is currently erased before runtime: ModuleMap stores flattened strings, StructTag retains one as display payload, RuntimeTypePredicate.named_structs reconstructs another from an opaque impl-target prefix, and BackendSchema/BackendProgram carry strings into interpreter/native/AOT schema selection. Moving only the final registry to a typed field would leave the string as semantic authority.

## Model

Use one borrowed structural term traversal with an explicit numeric mode. Strict mode returns Equal exactly for map-key identity: numeric kinds remain distinct at every depth, structural kinds and named-struct schema identity remain distinct, and Bitstring and ProcBin with equal bits are equal. Widening language comparison may equate integer and float values, but map keys always recurse in strict mode even when their containing map values use widening comparison.

Module identity is one typed ModuleName created at the source or builtin boundary and carried unchanged through ModuleMap, StructTag, World type predicates, retained backend products, all three execution doors, and SchemaRegistry. Tuple identity is its arity. Internal storage schemas are not language values. Nominal protocol targets have a typed variant in the existing opaque identity axis; they are neither prefixed strings nor fake structs. Display spellings, registry IDs, and World-local mint order are never comparison authority, and no parse/render adapter survives the cutover.

Closures compare as their typed source denotation plus one exact immutable runtime environment, recursively. Repeated construction of one lambda with equal environments is one key; different source lambdas or different environments are not. Do not assume CallableId, capture_tys, a wrapper specialization, or the current physical lane list already is that environment. Prove equality across wrappers and transport layouts. If equality-observable captured data is currently erased, retain it at the one closure construction boundary rather than reconstructing it during comparison.

Resources compare by the typed generative identity stored on the existing off-heap Resource owner. That identity is the resource value; payloads, destructors, stub addresses, and rendering are not.

Language construction publishes immutable finite term DAGs containing only finite floats; Erlang has no NaN or infinity runtime terms, so invalid low-level float ingress must fail before comparison. The mutation-built cyclic graph in the GC test proves collector reachability only; it is outside structural comparison. State and enforce the unpublished-construction boundary at low-level mutation APIs. Do not add a visited-set allocation, canonical serialization, or graph-normalization pass to ordinary comparison.

## Strategy

- Red-first tests cover raw slot/ref builders and all three execution doors with duplicate and freshly allocated tuple/list/nested-map keys.
- Replace the flattened module-name and prefixed nominal-target strings at their source-facing authorities. Carry ModuleName and a typed opaque-target variant through existing set algebra, backend products, and AOT; delete string lookup and parse/render bridges.
- Fold strict equality and total term ordering onto one borrowed comparator with explicit strict/widening numeric mode. Borrow Node and SchemaRegistry; never create a Process, clone schema vectors, box scalar adapters, serialize values, or render names.
- Route map construction normalization, binary search, put, delete, equality, ordering, and iteration through strict comparison. Normalize once at the publication or freeze boundary. Delete map_key_category helpers, same_value duplicates, raw-payload order, redundant pre-sorts, and repeated normalization scans.
- Preserve tuple versus named-struct identity, strict numeric distinctions at every depth, bitstring storage equivalence, stable last-wins behavior, and allocation-free absent deletion.
- Make quoted source consume normalized runtime entries. Validate the composite raw-map structural-address case on the combined fz-5xp.27 plus fz-tfn.62 branch; add no compiler comparator.

## Proof and gates

Tests cover all construction paths, mixed and nested keys, exact mixed-number boundaries, equal maps built in different orders, same-display/different-segment module and struct names, nominal-target set algebra, same and different closure environments across specializations, resource identity, moving GC, transport, deterministic quoted addressing, and unchanged scalar-box and allocation counters. Update semantic-authority, Map, any-value, and quoted-source documentation. Full lib, runtime, fixture, CLI, AOT integration, fmt, and warnings-denied clippy gates plus a fresh ticket-scoped cold review precede one commit and close.
title: Make one strict structural comparator own every map-key operation
